subject: Trial runway padding request — integration blocker with Aurora HealthTech
messages:
From: Rebecca Liu <rebecca.liu@aurorahealth.tech>
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.com
Cc: mike.jones@aurorahealth.tech
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Need a bit more runway — integration blocked by HL7 adapter

Hi Tessa,

Quick note from our side: our integration sprint hit an unexpected blocker with the HL7 adapter — the vendor patch we were waiting on slipped and our engineering team estimates ~8 business days to get the connector stable. We were planning to finalize the PoC in this trial window and now risk missing the demo to execs.

Can Redwood extend the trial credits / sandbox runway by one week so we can finish the connector work and complete the end-to-end tests? We're very close on the feature set and want to avoid restarting procurement conversations.

I can share logs and a short summary of the blocker if helpful. Really appreciate any flexibility here.

Best,
Rebecca Liu
Director of Integrations
Aurora HealthTech

Attachments: (none in this message)
From: tessa.morgan@redwood.com <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Rebecca Liu <rebecca.liu@aurorahealth.tech>
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 10:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Need a bit more runway — integration blocked by HL7 adapter

Rebecca — thanks for the context and for flagging this early. Sorry to hear the vendor patch slipped.

Two quick asks so I can move this internally:
- Can you upload the HL7 adapter logs (or a short zip) that shows the failure mode?
- Confirm the exact date your team expects to be demo-ready if we grant +7 days.

I'll loop in Aditya (AM) for the credits decision and Laura (SE) for a quick look at the logs. If we can validate it's a vendor-side delay (not a configuration issue), we typically approve short trial extensions to keep momentum.

If you want to attach the logs to a reply that will speed things up.

—Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0199

From: laura.bennett@redwood.com <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.com
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.com, Rebecca Liu <rebecca.liu@aurorahealth.tech>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 11:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Need a bit more runway — integration blocked by HL7 adapter

Adding a note from the SE side — happy to triage the logs. Rebecca, when you attach the zip please include a short runbook of steps you were executing and the expected vs actual HL7 payload (redact PHI). I can usually tell quickly if the issue is integration or vendor binary-related.

Also, if this is purely a vendor patch timeline I support a one-week extension to avoid disrupting the timeline. If we see configuration/usage errors we should discuss targeted enablement rather than blanket credits.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Mike Jones <mike.jones@aurorahealth.tech>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, tessa.morgan@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Need a bit more runway — integration blocked by HL7 adapter

Thanks Laura — attaching the logs and a short notes file from our eng lead. The zip includes stack traces and the failing binary checksum. We redacted patient data.

Attachments:
- integration-logs-aurora-20261103.zip (zip)
- hl7-adapter-notes.txt (txt)

We believe it's the vendor binary; vendor support said patch ETA ~8 business days. If Redwood can add one week (or a sandbox top-up of equivalent credits) we'd be able to complete the PoC demo week of Nov 16.

—Mike
Mike Jones
Senior Platform Engineer
Aurora HealthTech

From: laura.bennett@redwood.com <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com
Cc: Rebecca Liu <rebecca.liu@aurorahealth.tech>, Mike Jones <mike.jones@aurorahealth.tech>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Need a bit more runway — integration blocked by HL7 adapter

I reviewed the logs and the checksum mismatch aligns with a vendor binary regression — not a customer configuration error. The fail happens during handshake and the stack trace points at a vendor native module. I've attached a brief one-page summary for internal review.

Given the account stage (POC to execs next week) and the risk of restarting procurement, I'd recommend a one-week sandbox top-up (equivalent to 100k tokens) rather than a longer open-ended extension. That keeps alignment with our policy on short-term remediation and preserves runway for a clean handoff.

—Laura
(Internal attachment: sow-integration-plan-v2.pdf)
From: tessa.morgan@redwood.com <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: aditya.rao@redwood.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Request: approve 7-day sandbox top-up for Aurora (RDW-2026-374)

Aditya — quick ask. Aurora HealthTech (POC -> exec demo slated) hit a vendor HL7 binary regression. SE validated vendor-caused failure. They need one week of extra sandbox credits (recommended: 100k tokens) to complete tests and demo the PoC week of Nov 16.

Why approve:
- Deal is at exec demo step; procurement restart would add 6–8 weeks friction.
- Issue is vendor-side, not product misuse.
- Laura recommends a short, fixed top-up (not open-ended extension).

Attachments: Laura's triage summary and the logs (linked in the thread). If you can sign-off today I will confirm with Rebecca and issue the promo code.

Thanks —Tessa

From: aditya.rao@redwood.com <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: approve 7-day sandbox top-up for Aurora (RDW-2026-374)

Approved. Please issue a 7-day sandbox top-up equivalent to 100k tokens and mark it as 'vendor_delay_remedy' in the deal record. Add a note to cap further extensions; if they still need time after that we escalate to Sales Ops and Legal for an addendum.

Tessa — confirm the exact start/end timestamps you want on the promo and I'll have Monica publish the promo code and update HubSpot.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Rebecca — good news: we've approved a one-week sandbox top-up (100k tokens) to cover the vendor patch delay. Details:
- Promo code: AURORA-RDW-7D-100K
- Active: 2026-11-04T17:00:00Z through 2026-11-11T17:00:00Z
- Notes: tagged vendor_delay_remedy on deal RDW-2026-374; no further auto-extensions without Sales Ops review.

Best of luck on the demo prep — let us know if you want a quick pre-demo SLA test.
